card.fact_statement: The State Emergency Service responded to dozens of calls for assistance during the 2025 Queensland floods.
card.source_span: The State Emergency Service responded to dozens of calls for assistance across Ingham, Cardwell, Halifax, and other isolated communities.

card.fact_statement: Australian Defence Force personnel were deployed for search and rescue during the 2025 New South Wales floods.
card.source_span: Emergency Minister Kristy McBain stated that the Australian Defence Force personnel would be deployed for search and rescue on the night of 22 May to Taree.
